title: Remediate the open SonarCloud security and reliability findings on business scope
goal: Clear the SonarCloud quality-gate blockers for duanxldragon_pantheon-ops by fixing every open vulnerability and bug in the touched scope with real code, turning the 33-issue gosecurity:S3649 family into a machine-checked CI invariant, and only then transitioning the verified false positives in Sonar with a recorded, reversible justification.
dependsOn: 2026-10-29-sonar-ci-analysis-restore (the scan must run before its findings can be closed)
blocks: green SonarCloud quality gate on pantheon-ops main

in: ArgoCD client: always verify the server certificate; support private CAs through a stored PEM bundle instead of InsecureSkipVerify (go:S4830, go:S5527).
Filedist storage: confine resolved paths to the configured root and reduce upload names to one path element (gosecurity:S2083).
Add scripts/check-gorm-sql-literal.mjs plus node tests and a blocking docs-governance CI step so the S3649 false-positive argument is a checked invariant.
Fix the frontend floating-promise, nested-template, fixed-wait and cleartext-placeholder findings and the duplicated CI worker config in e2e-tests/playwright.config.ts.
Remove the hardcoded reachable target IP and implicit cleartext defaults from both e2e shell scripts by requiring explicit API_BASE_URL / WEB_BASE_URL.
Merge the byte-identical upgrade/rollback branches in service/state.go and move the CMDB import template example IP into the RFC 5737 documentation range.
Capture the S3649 issue keys, transition them with a written justification after the checker is merged, and read back the gate.
out: Mass refactoring of the legacy smell backlog outside the new-code period (go:S1192, go:S3776, typescript:S3358, typescript:S3863, godre:*, shell:S7688).
Any change to SonarCloud quality-gate definitions, the new-code period, or the organization plan.
Provisioning Dependabot secrets or changing the Dependabot scan policy.
Removing the external Vercel deployment check, which requires a maintainer action in the GitHub UI.
Adding a UI form for ArgoCD CA-certificate storage; caCert is API-only in this round.

doNotTouch: sonar-project.properties and .sonarcloud.properties (project identity and analysis scope are settled)
any repository secret value inside the working tree; SONAR_TOKEN is only ever a shell variable

implementationNotes: SonarGo reports gosecurity:S3649 for any GORM condition argument that is not a source-level literal, including package-level constants that are provably literal. Arguing 33 findings by hand does not survive the next analysis, so the invariant behind the argument is now enforced by scripts/check-gorm-sql-literal.mjs, unit-tested by tests/scripts/check-gorm-sql-literal.test.mjs and blocking in the docs-governance job.

The checker distinguishes GORM sinks from same-named methods on other receivers (the Kubernetes clientset Update(ctx, object, opts) has a different arity) and treats line-scoped waivers as visible output, never as silence. An empty justification is not a waiver.

retired_modules.go previously passed a column name into a built clause; the three IN clauses became package constants, matching the condNameEquals and menuPathWhereClause convention already used by the CMDB modules, and the two remaining dynamic-looking call sites carry visible waivers.

ArgoCD server certificate verification is now unconditional. A stored CA bundle adds trust; an unparseable bundle fails construction with ErrInvalidCACert instead of silently downgrading. The tests inject the httptest server certificate as the stored bundle, so they exercise the production path rather than bypassing it.
biz_argocd_server.ca_cert needs no SQL migration: the argocd module owns Migrate() with GORM AutoMigrate and no versioned SQL references that table.

e2e-tests/auto-test.sh shipped a reachable production IP and http:// defaults; requiring API_BASE_URL and WEB_BASE_URL removes the shell:S5332 class instead of marking it won't-fix, and the same change makes the scripts refuse to run against an unintended host.
The checker is an Ops-only sensor: base ships no backend/modules/business, so it is deliberately not proposed upstream and must not be hand-copied into base.

Round 2 was driven by the first hosted CI run rather than by local review: Go Lint reported one new gosec G304 on the line this round introduced (os.Create of a path that is already proven to stay inside the storage root), annotated consistently with the three G304 waivers already in that module, and the SonarCloud gate stayed ERROR only on new-code duplication because the new checker test file repeated its twelve test bodies. The test file became a CASES table with one driver loop, so the duplication is removed rather than the metric suppressed; the gate's security and reliability conditions were already OK on that analysis.

Post-merge read-back (round 3): the squash-merge landed on main as 9522048 and the push-triggered scan took open issues from 242 to 194, bugs from 6 to 0, and new_reliability_rating to OK. The only remaining gate ERROR is new_security_rating, whose whole residue is 33 gosecurity:S3649 plus 3 gosecurity:S2083 on the os.Remove cleanup sites in UploadFile. SonarGo accepted resolveWithinRoot as a sanitizer for os.Create but not for os.Remove on the same value, so those three are backed by TestUploadPathStaysInsideRootForAdversarialNames, which pins the flagged data flow end to end, and by the checker for the S3649 family. Nothing was transitioned before that test was main-merged.

Round 4 executed the transition last, against the merged tree: the checker and its 13 tests were re-run green on 52dfe28, the packages hosting every still-open sink passed, and each of the 18 remaining S3649 lines was read to confirm it is an Updates(map) with quoted literal keys or a First(&model, id) primary-key lookup. All 36 keys are now RESOLVED/FALSE-POSITIVE, open vulnerabilities went 36 to 0, and the branch gate reads OK on every condition. POST /api/issues/comment is not exposed by SonarCloud (404 Unknown url), so the justification is carried by sonar-triage.json and this packet instead of the issue thread, and /api/issues/search ignores issueKeys while rejecting RESOLVED in issueStatuses, which is why live state is matched client-side. The transition driver stayed outside the repository because it authenticates with a maintainer token; reversibility is per key via transition=to_reopen and no metric, new-code baseline or gate definition was edited.

consumerSpecificControls: SQL literalness in business GORM condition builders is a checked invariant, not a review convention
e2e scripts refuse to run without an explicitly supplied target
deferredCodeIssues: The legacy smell backlog outside the new-code period stays open after the transition: 158 findings, all CODE_SMELL (go:S1192 x68, go:S3776 x27, typescript:S3358 x20, typescript:S3863 x10, godre:* x10, typescript:S3776 x6, typescript:S6571 x6, typescript:S6551 x3, go:S107 x2, go:S1135 x2, githubactions:S1192 x2, typescript:S7770 x1, typescript:S7755 x1). Clearing it is a separate maintainability program, not a security gate.

Dependabot-triggered runs still cannot read SONAR_TOKEN, so SonarCloud Scan stays red on Dependabot PRs until Dependabot secrets are provisioned or the job skips that actor; that is a maintainer gate-policy decision.

The Vercel deployment check stays red and is out of scope by maintainer instruction: it is an external GitHub App integration with no committed configuration, its build log needs the Vercel team's credentials, and it is not a required status context on main, so disabling it is a GitHub App or Vercel dashboard action.
sonar.sources=. makes the scanner read PNG evidence files as source text; scoping that property is a Sonar configuration decision left with the maintainer.
No coverage report is produced, which is why sonar.coverage.exclusions=**/* stays in sonar-project.properties on the Free plan.
The ArgoCD UI has no server-registration form, so the new caCert field is reachable only through the API in this round.
